states: Opened and compared 14 matched captures from the real compiled Settings page at desktop light and narrow touch dark, using synthetic security-status responses.

SSO-only and local-password views report “Authentication” and “Configured or required” without claiming that a local password login was verified. SSO, proxy, and API token cues remain separate, and the scores, sibling cards, and footer release link retain their values or positions.
The limited-viewer screen and the scrolled phone hardening screen are pixel-identical. No protected posture score or API Access shortcut appears for the limited viewer.
interactions: 303 assertions on Chromium 141.0.7390.37 / Playwright 1.56.1. Reach Open API Access with Tab and Enter on desktop and by tapping at the same scroll position on the phone. Both reach the unchanged API Access scope-reference link.

Open the separate Authentication panel from the desktop local fixture and verify the configured user and the existing Change password control. No settings writes, provider sign-ins or external requests.
